usedFor: Paperform sends the signing events, and Freshsales Classic holds the deal that “Update Deal” changes when “Signer Signed” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “Signer Signed” in Paperform, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A signature is a deal milestone, and the action updates the deal's stage, amount or other fields.

watchOut: “Update Deal” finds the deal by deal ID or name, so check that the “Signer Signed” event carries one.
